summary: Sandbach United suffered a disappointing 3-2 defeat to Foley Meir in their opening match, squandering several chances and conceding soft free kicks that proved costly. The team will be looking to bounce back quickly when they host Stafford Town at home this Saturday in what promises to be a competitive clash against promotion contenders. Supporters are urged to get behind the side and create a strong atmosphere as the Bach look to get their season back on track.
